content.text: Both pass. Let's quickly review the final file.

Fixed: the post page had no `generateMetadata`, so every post used the layout's default tab title (`"tsuzuri"`) instead of the post's own title. Added `generateMetadata` in `app/(site)/posts/[slug]/page.tsx:31` that runs the same locale-resolution logic as the page body and sets `title` to the resolved translation's title — with the layout's `%s · tsuzuri` template, the tab now reads e.g. "Hello, world · tsuzuri". Typecheck and lint both pass; no tests existed for this route to update.
